From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@newco.com>, Asha Patel <asha.patel@newco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + next steps  Redwood x NewCo (economic buyer)

Hi Jordan (and Asha),

Thanks again for the chat this morning  really appreciate you walking through NewCo's high-level goals for Q4. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum:

- What we heard: NewCo wants to deploy an LLM-based summarization feature across your support and product docs. Key constraints are predictable latency under 150ms p50, data residency in US regions, and unit-cost under $0.002/token for production throughput.
- Decision criteria you mentioned: latency SLA, predictable pricing, SOC2/compliance evidence, and a clear procurement path.
- Stakeholder map we discussed: Jordan (product lead/initiator), Asha (procurement contact), and an economic/budget owner  you mentioned that might be Priya in finance but you were going to confirm.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer / budget owner and loop them in? If it's Priya, can you intro her to this thread so we can align on budget/timing?
2) I'll send a one-pager + mutual action plan that maps milestones, required security docs, and an initial SOW estimate.
3) Rishi (cc'd) will prepare a short perf/cost summary tailored to the traffic profile you shared.

Attachments: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SOW_NewCo_v1.pdf (pdf stub)

If you prefer a quick 20-min follow-up next week where we include procurement, happy to schedule  tell me what works.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Next steps & draft SOW  Redwood x NewCo

Hi Priya, Jordan, Asha 

Thanks for joining the quick sync today. Per our conversation, attaching a very small draft SOW and a mutual action plan that maps timeline, owners, and the security/compliance artifacts procurement typically requests.

TL;DR:
- Recommended starter: Redwood Hosted API (with SOC2 evidence) for POC, then transition to Dedicated if throughput/latency needs increase.
- Ballpark v1 pricing in the SOW is scoped for the initial POC (60-day evaluation) and includes an optional reserved-dedicated uplift in month 3.
- Procurement ask: standard PO, SOC2 report, SLA section to be agreed during contract redlines.

Attachments: SOW_NewCo_v1.pdf (pdf stub), Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Action items:
1) Priya  can you confirm target budget range for the POC and preferred procurement timeline? If you want, we can set a separate call with procurement to walk the SOW.
2) Asha  once Priya confirms, can you share any required legal redline templates or vendor questionnaire scopes we should expect?
3) Rishi  can you post the perf/cost summary to the shared Drive folder and flag any hard limits or recommendations for instance sizing.

Happy to jump on a call if that helps close the loop faster.

Best,
